subject.title: feat: model-centric usage & spend view across providers (Scope B from #2257)

question: Should the model card aggregate every matching model record across provider sources even when the sources may describe the same underlying usage, or should the initial release preserve source-separated totals until an overlap/deduplication rule exists?
rationale: The implementation intentionally leaves sources non-deduplicated, while the related feature discussion identifies double counting as a core product-accuracy risk; code review cannot choose the permanent meaning of a displayed total.

options.title: Keep totals source-separated
options.body: Show per-provider provenance and avoid presenting a cross-source summed total until an explicit overlap model is available.

options.title: Approve exact-match aggregation
options.body: Accept the current aggregation semantics only with clear user-facing wording that totals can include overlapping provider histories.

options.title: Defer the model card
options.body: Pause Scope B until canonical model identity and duplicate-source policy are designed together.

recommendation.title: Keep totals source-separated
recommendation.body: Show per-provider provenance and avoid presenting a cross-source summed total until an explicit overlap model is available.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-level product and data-accuracy contract rather than a mechanical implementation choice.
